name: Hunting in Stranglethorn
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Long ago, a dwarf came to this land.  His name was Hemet and he wished to hunt great beasts.  His skills with the rifle were uncanny, and we spent many days hunting together.  Even the enmity between our peoples was forgotten.

When he left Desolace for Stranglethorn, I vowed to one day welcome him back so that we may hunt again.  Now is that time.

Take this kodo horn as a gift to Hemet.  He will know it is from me.  You will find him in Stranglethorn, north of the Grom'gol Base camp.
narrative.objectives: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, this horn belongs to a Tauren, Roon Wildmane. He and I had a good time hunting the beasts of Desolace. So Roon is inviting me back, is he?

We're neck deep in the jungle right now, but thank you, adventurer. Perhaps my next expedition will take me back to Desolace, the land of the centaurs.
narrative.requestItemsText: Sit, Champion. Soon enough you'll strike back into the jungle.
